run_tesseract_ocr: run tesseract_ocr on an image with bounding boxes and language to extract text lines
run_tesseract_ocr_parallel: run tesseract_ocr_parallel on multiple images with bounding boxes and languages for batch OCR
run_tesseract_bboxes: run tesseract_bboxes on an image to detect bounding boxes for text regions
run_tesseract_parallel: run tesseract_parallel on multiple images to detect bounding boxes in parallel
summarize_surya_lang_to_tesseract: summarize surya_lang_to_tesseract that maps a surya language code to a tesseract language code
